newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Plane crash in Congo kills 27 - businessmen.
newsitem.headline: Plane crash in Congo kills 27 - businessmen.

text.p: Twenty-seven people died in a plane crash near Bunia in the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on Friday evening, businessmen in the capital said on Sunday.

The businessmen, in touch with the region by radio from Kinshasa, said that the propeller aircraft, of local airline Bazair, had developed technical problems shortly after leaving Bunia, near the Ugandan border, for Kisangani.
"The plane crashed about 40 km (25 miles) west of Bunia and burst into flames," said one businessman who lost relatives in the accident. "So far we only know of four bodies having been recovered."

For those with enough money, aircraft are the only quick means of transport across Africa's third largest country. Roads fell into disrepair during three decades of misrule and corruption under former president Mobutu Sese Seko.
President Laurent Kabila, who ousted Mobutu last month, has promised to improve transport structures in the sprawling former Zaire.
